entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I please get your name and order number?
Mark Peterson. The order number should be in your system.
Okay, thank you, Mark. I've found your recent order for the Pro-Series cycling shoes. To proceed, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them?
They don't fit. They gave me terrible blisters after one ride.

I'm very sorry to hear that; that sounds painful. I know our product team would want to know, did you get a chance to make any adjustments to the cleats or the internal strapping before you decided they weren't for you?
Look, I've tried. They're just bad. I want a refund.
I understand completely. Let me just verify the delivery date to check the return eligibility... It looks like the shoes were delivered 41 days ago. One moment while I review the policy.

Thank you for your patience, Mark. I've checked our knowledge base, and for standard items like these cycling shoes, we have a 90-day return window. You're well within that period, so I can definitely process this return for you.

I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. Please attach it to the original packaging, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, your full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can do for you?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
